title: Android Development with Kotlin
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of android development with kotlin using at least one correct term from the lesson.
Interpret or adapt a small Kotlin example that demonstrates android development with kotlin.
Identify one relevant edge case, debugging step, or version/platform constraint.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Android Development with Kotlin** as part of **Kotlin for Android Development**. Android application code must respect lifecycle, UI-thread rules, accessibility, permission boundaries, and the compatibility of Android/Compose dependencies. Use the subtopics—Android Application Architecture, Android Studio Project Structure, Kotlin's Role in Android Development—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Android code must account for lifecycle changes, accessibility, UI state, and platform APIs. Isolating business logic makes the interface easier to test.

content_blocks.text: Android Development with Kotlin removes the need to test boundary conditions or verify the chosen runtime/library version.

content_blocks.title: Troubleshooting and reset
content_blocks.text: If the example fails, first confirm which runtime/project type the snippet requires. Read the first useful compiler or runtime message, check imports and declared dependencies, reduce the example to a minimal case, and rerun. For target-specific code, use the target toolchain rather than assuming a console or browser runner can execute it.
